description: This file defines a React functional component `RouterConfigBuilder` that provides a user interface for configuring routing rules for models, including adding/removing routes, selecting models, defining descriptions, score thresholds, and example utterances. It manages internal state and synchronizes with parent component via `onChange` callback.

methods.name: RouterConfigBuilder
methods.description: React functional component that manages routing configuration UI, including route adding, removing, editing, and JSON preview.
